apparatus.crit: vatsān kaliṇgāṃs taralān aśmakān r̥ṣikāṃs tathā yo
me jahi śatrugaṇān sarvān mahendra iva dānavān
taṃ hatvādya mahābāho vijayas tava phalguna
samāhatā; bhr̥śaṃ ca tat tat kulabhāṣiṇo
tam avidhyat tribhir bāṇair dandaśūkair ivāhibhiḥ
kṣurair bhallārdhacandraiś ca chinnāḥ śastrāṇi tatyajuḥ
vikr̥ṣya balavac cāpaṃ tava putrāya so ’sr̥jat
khaḍgaiś ca saṃsyūtān r̥ṣṭibhiś ca narādhipa
bhagnākṣakūbarān kāṃś cic chinnacakrāṃś ca māriṣa
bāhūn ūrūṃś ca chinnān anyāṃs tathā yudhi
kr̥te ’vahāre sainyānāṃ pravr̥tte ca raṇe punaḥ
eṣām eva kr̥to bhāgo navadhā pr̥tanāpate
devānām asurāṇāṃ ca mahān āsīt samāgamaḥ
kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha
mām asmād abhiprāyāt kaś cid adya
paridāya nr̥paṃ tebhyaḥ saṃgrāmaś cābhavad yathā
suṣeṇāyāsr̥jad bhīmas tam apy asyācchinad vr̥ṣaḥ
ete ca tvaritā vīrā vasuṣeṇam avārayan
iṣudhī cāsya ciccheda rathaṃ ca tilaśo ’cchinat
śatānīkaṃ ca navabhir dharmaputraṃ ca saptabhiḥ
ketūn; aśvān rathān pattigaṇān dvipāṃś ca
sa hi teṣāṃ mahāvīryo dvīpo ’bhūt sumahābalaḥ
kr̥cchram etat; karṇasyāntād etad antāḥ stha
tān pañcabhiḥ sa tv ahanat pr̥ṣatkaiḥ;
tribhir yudhāmanyum avidhyad āśugais; tribhis tribhiḥ
navajaladasavarṇair hastibhis tān udīyur; giriśikharanikāśair bhīmavegaiḥ
tv evaṃ kathaṃ cit syāl lokaparyasanaṃ
athābravīt krodhasaṃraktanetraḥ; karṇaḥ śalyaṃ saṃdhiteṣuḥ prasahya
yaśaś ca dharmaś ca jayaś ca māriṣa;
tu yat tat svavaśaṃ pravr̥ttaṃ; tat pāṇḍavān pāti
rathair vareṣūn mathitaiś ca yodhaiḥ; saṃsyūtasūtāśvavarāyudhadhvajaiḥ
